action_trace.summary: Generated 10 interview questions using 5W1H and Socratic techniques to elicit end-user goals (IDE support, type safety), pain points (runtime errors, poor IDE autocomplete, friction in development), and acceptance criteria (abstract Transformer class with properly typed fit/transform methods). Generated 10 interview questions using 5W1H and Socratic techniques to probe: (1) concrete pain points with sklearn's missing type hints, (2) impact scope and affected personas, (3) desired abstract class structure, (4) acceptance criteria specificity, and (5) prioritization context.
